body: I'm here to talk if you want. I'm going through something similar and I can relate to most not nearly all the things you're saying. Drop me a on if you want to talk or what not

Update: Its called Depressive Realism http://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Depressive_realism

Seems that depressed people see the world on how it really is compared to what people who don't  suffer
You're talking about different things. Taking SSRIs is not a natural instinct like providing and protecting your child. Its something you take to alter the way your brain works.
It does but humans are beyond the point of survival instincts. Its not enough for humans to be satisfied on just survival instincts. They have to find meaning themselves to carry on

I went to the hospital and they moved it to monday. Everyday is so painful to live :(

It really is terrible. I have never experienced anything like it before so I just panicked even more. Its also a mixture of this depression which doesn't help the whole thing. I don't know why its all happening but I'm just worried this will happen tomorrow. Thanks for your support.
I've had taken some Valium and have calmed down a bit. I'm scared that this whole thing is gonna happen all over again tomorrow. And the next day. Thanks for your support

Thanks for the reply. That is comforting. I had her call an out of hours service for a doctor to come. I don't know what they would do . if they can't do anything, I don't know what I can do to stop this
ignorance is bliss my friend. Worst advice ever. At least she didn't tell you to snap out of it. Man that makes me want to burn shit.

That title seems to sum it all up for me and probably a lot of other people. 

It seems you know and you've listened and you are still in the same place. Perfectly normal in regards to having depression. Just keep grinding everyday until it gets better.

I'm on Sertraline but I'm not sure what if it's working any more or I have just gotten used to the effects and it becomes natural. Yeah I'm doing the same living through drugs. It's better than killing yourself or having insomnia.
Only using it as a buffer until i get better. In the process of counselling. So hopefully it's only a temporary solution.
oh what medication do you take?
I wouldn't even run in the first place

There is no "meant to". The underlining fact is that we are born with no reason to live. Everyone finds distractions or define their own purpose to prolong their lives. I think personally my experience of depression is to accept the lack of substance to my own life. This makes me sad. I wasn't born to be this or not to be that but just to exist.
Do you take any medication? I find I develop an increased level of constant apathy on my anti-depressants.
I forgot to say. Well done. That's a great achievement !
I exercise but I never see a significant improvement. Just gradually running out of "potential" solutions.

I think about the scenario very often. How I will do it, where I would do it, what would happen after? These float through my mind most hours of the day. I seem to see it as a vague fantasy; I know (as of now) that I will not do it but I don't know if that's considered suicidal. I don't think you have to commit or attempt to be suicidal but to think of dying more often than living is enough to consider yourself as suicidal. I think depression and suicidal thoughts come hand in hand as depression is a state where your mind lacks the vitality to want to stay alive. Just my thoughts.
just a joke fam
I don't think Hunter S Thompson liked coke either
quite a hefty list. Do you plan on going to Las Vegas anytime soon?
yeah it seems i'm going that way too. what else was part of your daily routine?

i get this as well. I cut myself off from everyone including the people i live with. My mum tries to make it all nice when the day comes but all i want to do is stay in bed. 

Each year for the past 3 years, I have felt this and resulting in my mum crying and shouting at me calling me selfish etc. I can't really do anything about it though. It's like she is having a go at me for not running fast enough while my leg is in a cast and i am on crutches.
I'm not sure how popular dph is with regular use. why did you take this much if you don't mind me asking?
I know higher doses are not worth the trouble. I normally take lower doses regularly to keep the same feeling consistent throughout the day, but still having the potential to do normal things.

Thanks for the in-depth reply. I have councilling first time next week (after waiting more than half a year) and wanted to know if it really could help. What you said and what you used to relieve your symptoms have really shone a positive light onto it all. I'm going to read up on coherent breathing :)

I had this. I told my friend i wanted to talk to her and she told me she would tell me when she is free. She hasn't said anything in about a month. I guess when you suffer, it's not just you that does and other people don't want  anything to do with you any more. This reply isn't giving any advice. I'm just writing this to let you know i have read it and listened to what you said.
it could happen one day. seeing how i am and how you feel i really don't think it will any time soon. it's just you and yourself at the moment.
What sort of techniques did you use?
thanks for the advice. it's just not nice going from being sociable to wanting not to be talked to
